instruction: Christopher has asked for my movie recommendations via phone text message. Reply to them with a list of comma-separated movie titles from my Simple Note account as per their request.
notes: Fixed the name clash: the predicate formerly named requested-director collided with the object of the same name; the predicate is now request-director-of and the object is christopher-requested-director. Model otherwise unchanged: supervisor.show_profile supplies the phone username (phone number) and simple_note username (email); show_account_passwords supplies passwords. phone.search_contacts discovers Christopher's phone number; phone.search_text_messages filtered by that number finds the request text and thereby the requested director; simple_note.search_notes (dont_reorder_pinned=true) locates the movie note and show_note reveals its content. The reply message is statically tied (reply-for) to the director and note so send_text_message is only applicable after both lookups. Goal demands one text sent to Christopher with the filtered titles, then supervisor.complete_task (no answer) last; every other action requires (not (task-completed)).
